branded.why: The Italian infant food since 1902, on which generations of Italian children were raised.

about.text: An Italian brand founded in Milan in 1902 as the Italian Plasmon Syndicate by Cesare Scotti. Its original product was an albumin milk powder for infants, and the brand now also makes biscuits and other foods.

sources.text: The founding, the original product and the current maker, from the article.
